metaTitle: Custom Cotton Poly Beanies | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom cotton poly beanies for your team or event. Perfect for embroidery or screen printing. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Cotton poly beanies combine the softness of cotton with the durability of polyester, making them a practical choice for year-round giveaways. The blend resists shrinking and holds color well, so your logo stays sharp through repeated wear. These beanies are ideal for outdoor events, employee gifts, or retail merch where comfort and longevity matter. Decorate with embroidery or screen printing for a crisp, lasting impression.
